cost.binNote: Bin's raw CassiopeiaE cost value is 40 mana. The wiki states 45 (a plain literal, not a template), and ddragon's public spell data also lists 45 for all 5 ranks. Reporting the wiki's number per instructions; the bin disagrees and is not resolved here.

values.meaning: Bonus magic damage dealt on top of the basic damage when the target is poisoned
Basic magic damage dealt by every Twin Fang cast, regardless of whether the target is poisoned
values.binNote: Bin's level-18 value is 119.999, not exactly 120; the wiki's {{pplevel|50 to 120}} rounds the endpoint for display. Treated as a floating-point rounding artifact, not a substantive disagreement.

mechanics.claim: Twin Fang's bonus magic damage (and its heal) only applies when the target is currently poisoned (e.g. by Noxious Blast or Miasma); otherwise only the basic damage is dealt.
mechanics.quote: Against a {{tip|poison|poisoned}} target, ''Twin Fang'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Cassiopeia'''.

mechanics.claim: If Twin Fang is cast while an already-thrown Noxious Blast has not yet exploded, Twin Fang's own damage waits at the target until Noxious Blast explodes before applying.
mechanics.quote: Upon reaching the target, ''Twin Fang'' will wait for an ongoing {{ai|Noxious Blast|Cassiopeia}} to explode before dealing its damage.

mechanics.claim: If a Twin Fang cast kills the target, its mana cost is refunded.
mechanics.quote: If this kills the target, ''Twin Fang's'' {{as|{{sti|mana|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
